verdict.rationale: Angular is a web development framework, not a data-holding application, so getting AI-generated insights from a user's own data inside the product is a category error for this kind of product. The 'AI-forward resources and integrations' and the AI section cover AI-assisted development (prompts, best practices), not data insights, and do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
